module: Auxiliary controller that displays a live navigation map on a vehicle screen. It creates an HTML texture (`htmlTexture` module) on a screen material, asks the game for the dashboard map (`ui_uinavi.requestVehicleDashboardMap`) and sends it 15 times per second the vehicle's position, orientation, speed and ignition, as long as a player is seated.
notes: Jbeam keys read by init: `screenMaterialName` ("@screen_gps"), `htmlFilePath` ("local://local/vehicles/common/navi_screen.html"), `textureWidth` (256), `textureHeight` (128), `textureFPS` (30), `bootscreenImage` (optional URL of the boot screen).
Data sent to `map.updateData`: x, y, rotation (degrees = direction + 180), speed (km/h = airspeed × 3.6), zoom (min(150 + speed × 1.5, 250), unused on the dashboard), ignitionLevel.
`M.reset = nop` (empty function): without it controller.reset would call init again and recreate the texture. The `reset` field is therefore not nil.
The call uses `obj:getID()` for the vehicle identifier.

reset.desc: nop: avoids calling init again on vehicle reset.

updateGFX.desc: Sends the GPS data to the HTML texture at 15 Hz when a player is seated.

init.desc: Creates the screen's HTML texture, asks the game for the map and displays the boot image if `bootscreenImage` is provided.
